title: CGI Imaging Internship - Summer 2027
note: 3D product-rendering intern on Uline's Imaging team; open to junior-status students, and housing is provided for out-of-town interns.

facts.duties: Build photoreal 3D product images for Uline's web and print catalog, match CGI lighting and camera to the photography, and follow the brand style guides with the Imaging team.
facts.requirements: Junior-status bachelor's student; 3D modeling, rendering and texturing from coursework or a portfolio; 3ds Max, Blender or Maya; basic Adobe CC, with Photoshop preferred.
facts.apply: Apply Now on uline.jobs (links to Uline's Workday portal), job ID R268436.
